source: Codex re-probe cat (first initialize took 38.1 s with a fresh CODEX_SQLITE_HOME) and c6 (tool-free turn), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; the 38.1 s wait is replayed as 1.5 s

params.prompt: Reply with exactly VIA_ENV_159. Do not use any tools.

expect.notes: The initialize reply is delayed (38.1 s live, 1.5 s here): the handshake deadline is the turn's remaining wall time, never a shorter fixed bound (vendors/codex.md §2 Shared ownership; adapters design §2 cold start). The instance version is parsed from initialize.userAgent `via/0.159.2 (...)`: the token after the client name and `/` (C2 §5; vendors/codex.md §1). argv pins `--disable hooks` (vendors/codex.md §4). One keyless usage sample gives scope turn (C2 §5 AD6).
